source: Cricbuzz 'IPL 2027 - All retentions and releases' (17 Nov 2026), cross-checked against Willow Sports / Times of India. Trade-in players are included in retained lists to match the published purse and slot tables.
note: Per-player retention salaries were not published; purse and slot figures are official. MS Dhoni (CSK mentor) and Ajinkya Rahane retired and are not in the auction pool. Player impact and value ratings are editorial estimates for the simulation. Mayank Agarwal, Abhinav Manohar and Ben Duckett appear in neither published column and are treated as released. Auction pool is provisional until the official register on 3 Dec 2026.
